'''Keshiri''' was the language spoken by members of the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was in use by the species around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], when a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|group]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] crashed on the planet in their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Omen]]''. The Keshiri, who believed the Sith to be [[Skyborn|their gods]], began to [[Slavery/Legends|serve]] them, and learned [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. By [[41 ABY]], many Keshiri spoke this language, although they still used their native tongue and retained the accompanying lilting accent. This language was also spoken by certain [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of the Sith Tribe, including [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] and his daughter, [[Vestara Khai|Vestara]]. While meeting briefly aboard the [[Jade Shadow|ship]] of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], the two Sith used it to communicate with each other so that the Skywalkers could not understand what they were saying, knowing that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would be recording their conversation. Luke Skywalker presented the recording to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], who managed to provide a rough translation of their words, despite never having come into contact with the language before.
''[[Criik]]'' and ''[[Sharstung]]'' were known curse words of the Keshiri language and ''[[Ese]]'' meant yes. Also there are some known numbers such as: zero as ''oh'', two as ''wees'', three as ''ees'', four as ''nesh'' and seven as ''set''.
